title: Denoise the input
summary: Smooths the network's input before the stem: none, a Gaussian blur or a median filter.
does: A forward pre-hook before the stem (tools/train_blocks.py DENOISERS): none, gaussian or median, on every crop the network reads, in training and in evaluation alike. It changes no type.

inputs.name: data
inputs.what: 2-D frames or crops the network reads.

outputs.name: data
outputs.what: The same data: the hook lives inside the model.

generic.why: The denoisers are hooks on the 2-D network's input (tools/train_blocks.py); a volume or a clip would need hooks of its own.
